dashboard.plateauDesc: Your weight has been stable for 14 days. Try varying your exercise routine or hydration.
dashboard.lowHungerDesc: Prioritize light, protein-dense meals: eggs, yogurt or a shake.
tips: Drink at least 2.5 L (about 85 fl oz) of water a day to help your kidneys process fat breakdown.
Prioritize protein at every meal to avoid losing muscle mass.
If you feel nauseous, try eating smaller portions and avoiding fried foods.
Constipation is common; increase your fiber intake and consider a supplement.
Keep a regular sleep schedule; rest is key to hormonal balance.
dashboard.reducedIntervalText_one: Only {{count}} day has passed since your last dose. Taking the medication before the 6–7 day interval may increase the risk of side effects. Do you want to proceed anyway?
dashboard.reducedIntervalText_other: Only {{count}} days have passed since your last dose. Taking the medication before the 6–7 day interval may increase the risk of side effects. Do you want to proceed anyway?
dashboard.rotationTip: * Rotating injection sites is essential to prevent lipodystrophy and ensure the medication is absorbed properly.

bodySelector.abdomenDesc: The area around the belly button (stay about 2 in / 5 cm away from it). Offers steady absorption thanks to the fatty tissue.
bodySelector.thighDesc: Easy for self-injection. May be more sensitive for people with low body fat.
bodySelector.armDesc: The triceps area. Fast absorption, but usually needs someone else's help.
bodySelector.rotationDesc: Alternating sites prevents scarring, irritation and lipodystrophy (fatty lumps), keeping the medication effective.
bodySelector.rotationExample: e.g. Wk 1 (Right Abdomen) → Wk 2 (Left Abdomen) → Wk 3 (Right Thigh)...
bodySelector.care1: Clean the site with alcohol before injecting
bodySelector.care2: Don't inject into bruised or damaged skin
bodySelector.care3: Don't massage the area after the injection
bodySelector.care4: Dispose of needles in a proper sharps container
